author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Many of us loose our loved ones in our lives.
On 3/3/2015 Alexanders(ScriptingLyfe) Father has died today. I had the same problem with this. My dog died 3 weeks ago. I wish to name a map after Carlos, or Alexanders father, in honor of his service in what is called "Lyfe"
Alexander still helps us today by hosting a server for players to build maps on. His dad taught Alex how to be a good person really well.

Map: Karurosu(Japanese For Carlos)

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/d5gb9oidbj6t46p/Seth5.rar
Images: http://imgur.com/a/msYXJ
YML: http://pastebin.com/QjNmNVEv
